title: Pan-Seared Parsnip Fritters with French Twist
description: Crispy parsnip fritters infused with French flavors, served with a side of sweet chutney. A delightful twist on the classic French cuisine.
instructions: Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 350°F (175°C).
In a bowl, mix together the grated parsnip, flour, breadcrumbs, egg, melted butter, salt, and pepper.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into small patties.
Dust the patties with flour, shaking off any excess.
Carefully place the patties in the hot oil and fry for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Using a slotted spoon, remove the fritters from the oil and drain on paper towels.
Serve hot with a side of sweet chutney, if desired.
